content:
I have built Lean from source (https://github.com/leanprover/lean4/blob/master/doc/make/index.md#generic-build-instructions), but now I cannot use the version of lean I have just built (dev), even after running these commands:

elan toolchain link lean4 build/dev/stage1
elan toolchain link lean4-stage0 build/dev/stage0

yet

yalihupokn@zoqu-endiman:~/Repositories/ln/lean4$ lean --version
Lean (version 4.29.1, aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, commit f72c35b3f637c8c6571d353742168ab66cc22c00, Release)
yalihupokn@zoqu-endiman:~/Repositories/ln/lean4$

Am I missing something?
It seems lean-toolchain files refer to ../build/release/stage1 directly, so the linking is not respected

pandaman said:

It seems lean-toolchain files refer to ../build/release/stage1 directly, so the linking is not respected

I changed the contents to build/dev/stage1 instead

Thank you, that was it.

[UPDATE]

I then had to run elan default lean-toolchain inside that same directory to make it the system-wide default. I needed the latest version as my arm64 system suffers from this bug otherwise! <- doesn't work

pandaman said:

It seems lean-toolchain files refer to ../build/release/stage1 directly, so the linking is not respected

Hmm, I can use it when I'm in the lean4 directory, but I need to somehow override the version specified in https://github.com/nomeata/loogle with the latest when building it
I gave up using the dev build and just built the release one:sweat_smile:
